options.textEn: Hold a piece of the stone it was cut from.
Watch the statue go around above the beds.
Look at the statue from every side.

options.textEn: Handle a fragment of the original block of marble.

View the sculpture in the round, from every angle.

milano_castello_q3@B2.questionJa: 現在のピエタの展示では、来場者は何ができますか？

source.questionEn: What draws viewers so close to Mantegna's Dead Christ?

An extreme view along the length of the body.
A portrait of the viewer beside the mourners.

milano_brera_c_q1.questionJa: マンテーニャの《死せるキリスト》で、見る人を近くへ引き込む表現は何ですか。

optionsJa.A: 遠くまで続く長い行列。

optionsJa.C: 嘆く人々の隣に描かれた鑑賞者の肖像。

source.questionEn: What makes people feel very close to Mantegna's Dead Christ?

options.textEn: A long line of people going far away into the picture.
A very unusual view: we look along the body from its feet.
A picture of the person who is looking, next to the people who are crying.

milano_brera_c_q1@A2.questionJa: マンテーニャの《死せるキリスト》に、人々がとても近く感じるのはなぜですか？

options.textEn: A lengthy procession receding into the distance.
A radically foreshortened view along the length of the body.
A portrait of the onlooker positioned beside the mourners.

milano_brera_c_q1@B2.questionJa: マンテーニャの《死せるキリスト》に、鑑賞者がこれほど間近に引き寄せられるのはなぜですか？

optionsJa.A: 遠くへ遠ざかっていく長い行列。
optionsJa.B: 体の長さに沿って見る、極端に短縮された視点。
optionsJa.C: 嘆く人々の傍らに置かれた、見る人の肖像。
